title: chresta martii
intro: Chresta martii, commonly known as the Martius' Chresta or Brazilian chamomile, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to alleviate various health issues, with reported health benefits including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which may help soothe digestive problems, reduce anxiety, and promote relaxation. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the body's response to stress, improve sleep quality, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Chresta martii include flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
